item.title: Passenger describes ‘eerie’ landing after nationwide ground stop for flights
item.what: The FAA has issued a nationwide ground stop, halting departing flights at U.S. airports — all airlines — until further notice. This is a ground stop, not emergency landings: planes already in the air keep flying and land normally.
item.means: If you or family are flying today, expect major delays and cancellations nationwide, even at airports that look fine.
item.do: Check with your airline before heading to the airport, and keep checking — schedules will keep changing while the stop is in effect.
